PRODUCT_READINESS_ASSESSMENT.SUMMARY: Synapse is now a credible developer-tool beta with strong MyGRACE integrity, real Linux/macOS release/install coverage, release-candidate dry-run discipline before publishing, Node 24-ready GitHub Actions, hardened MCP/bootstrap/index lifecycle behavior, and public documentation/release metadata aligned with shipped behavior. Remaining readiness risk is concentrated in deferred Windows packaging and broader end-user support diagnostics.

EVIDENCE.MYGRACE_DRIFT: 0 canonical drift across 70 code modules, graph shards, and verification shards
EVIDENCE.CI_GATE: Full scripts/ci.sh gate passes, including fmt, clippy, runtime guard, tests, release smoke, verify, review, refresh, and status
EVIDENCE.RELEASE_SMOKE: GitHub release run 26120421918 built Linux x86_64, Linux aarch64, macOS x86_64, and macOS arm64 artifacts, aggregated SHA256SUMS, and published v2.3.5 through Node 24-ready release actions and CLI artifact download
EVIDENCE.INSTALLER_TRUTH: Public main installer installed v2.3.5 from the Linux x86_64 release artifact with SHA256 verification; installer maps Linux/macOS x86_64 and arm64 hosts to declared prebuilt artifacts and keeps cargo source fallback
EVIDENCE.ACTIONS_RUNTIME: Hosted main CI run 26120689647 and release run 26120421918 completed with no Node.js 20, DEP0040, DEP0005, or deprecation log markers
EVIDENCE.PHASE7_GATE: Local Phase-7 hardening gate passed: 74 tests, clippy -D warnings, runtime guard, release smoke, verify --ci, review --mode full, refresh drift=0, and scripts/ci.sh
EVIDENCE.PHASE8_GATE: Local Phase-8 gates passed: docs parity, release tag guard, release smoke with packaged version assertion, cargo audit --deny warnings, all-target tests, clippy -D warnings, refresh drift=0, and verify --ci
EVIDENCE.PHASE9_GATE: Local Phase-9 gates passed: release_candidate tests, docs parity, all-target tests, clippy -D warnings, release-candidate dry-run with explicit v2.3.5 tag, release smoke, and scripts/ci.sh with verify/review
EVIDENCE.DOC_TRUTH: Public README, INSTALL, COMMANDS, FAQ, QUICKSTART, and WORKFLOW docs are guarded against ghost CLI commands, unsupported installer URLs, obsolete synapse-ai release paths, and unsupported Windows install claims
EVIDENCE.RELEASE_DISCIPLINE: Release workflow rejects tag/version mismatches, publishes generated release notes, verifies SHA256SUMS, and runs release smoke for Linux/macOS artifacts
EVIDENCE.EVIDENCE_RELEASE_CANDIDATE_DISCIPLINE: Manual release-candidate workflow and real release workflow both run a dry-run gate for tag/version policy, generated release notes, checksum aggregation, installer dry-run mapping, and Linux/macOS smoke coverage before release publishing
EVIDENCE.SUPPLY_CHAIN: notify updated to 8.2.0; Cargo.lock no longer includes instant; hosted CI security job enforces cargo audit --deny warnings
EVIDENCE.MCP_PROTOCOL: syn mcp keeps stdout protocol-clean and JSON-RPC notifications silent
EVIDENCE.INDEX_LIFECYCLE: Full re-index removes deleted-file search entries and syn index --no-git is covered by regression tests
EVIDENCE.BOOTSTRAP_CONFIG: syn init followed by syn doctor accepts built-in default config on clean machines, and existing OpenCode MCP siblings survive Synapse config merge

RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_WINDOWS_DEFERRED: Windows prebuilt install remains intentionally deferred beyond Phase-5
RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_NON_DEVELOPER_INSTALL: Non-Linux/macOS users still require source fallback or future platform artifacts
RESIDUAL_RISKS.RISK_SUPPORT_DIAGNOSTICS: Linux/macOS installer failure messages can be further improved for non-expert users

PRODUCT_READINESS_ASSESSMENT.NEXT_PHASE: Phase-10 Adoption Feedback and Support Readiness
